prompts.name: 01-industrial-workshop
prompts.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE high-fidelity full-screen desktop game UI concept, landscape 16:9, for the existing 'Factory Maths' educational factory-building game played on a large touchscreen smartboard by grade 7–8 students. The provided screenshot is a reference for the existing functionality, game world and orange industrial machines, NOT a demand to retain its plain UI. Redesign the complete interface: header, buttons, tool palette, mission cards, camera controls and selected-building popup. Keep the green isometric factory board, dark conveyor belts with silver rails and cyan arrows, orange wood extractor with a log claw, orange/silver plank sawmill and delivery station recognizably consistent. Show a working short line on the board with logs and planks. UI must be the star, exceptionally polished game UI, clear typographic hierarchy, consistent designed icons and spacious large finger-friendly buttons. No photography, device frame, people, tiny unreadable text, dense engineering dashboard, extra game mechanics or fantasy scenery. Entire interface visible without cropping. Board occupies about two-thirds of screen with right mission sidebar and full-width bottom toolbar. Header: 'OIS / Factory Maths', 'Teams & levels', 'Upgrade shop', gear Settings. Level heading 'First planks', 'Level 01 / 12', Team 1, Credits 88, Delivered / min 12. Right side has THREE mission cards with star and progress: 'Deliver the goods' 8 / 12 planks; 'Balance the flow' 12 / min; 'Build economically' 32 / 90 credits; prediction card 'Your prediction' 24 and 'Revise'. Bottom clearly separate tools Inspect, Multi-select, Move view, Belt (selected), Extractor, Planks, Remove; each has a large consistent illustrative icon, name and cost where relevant. Separate controls Rotate, Undo, Pause, 1×, Restart. Floating board camera − 100% + Fit. One small selected-machine popup showing 'Plank workshop', circular info button, rotate-left and rotate-right and Delete, showing how contextual controls would look. Keep all text minimal, legible and functional. UI proportions and artwork should be realistically implementable in HTML/CSS/canvas, not concept fantasy. Visual direction: INDUSTRIAL WORKSHOP. Warm charcoal and slate-blue UI frames with orange/copper and amber accents, light ivory readable mission cards. Handsome tactile beveled rectangular buttons with subtly raised edges, inset machine thumbnail tiles, clear thin metallic frame lines. Oversized amber Pause button, cyan selected-tool glow with orange accent only for machine actions, physical workshop control-panel aesthetic. Premium strategy-game UI, restrained micro texture and bolts only at panel corners, no hazard stripe overload, clean and visually striking. Consistent icon badges with miniature orange machinery. Header and bottom toolbar form a cohesive industrial console around the existing green board.
